name: m2-metrics-tamarind

brief.objective: Define paid revenue and paying customers per month for Tamarind Loop Software (fictional) and reconcile them to the finance-reported totals.

intake.kpis: paid_revenue_YYYY_MM and paying_customers_YYYY_MM for July and August 2026 (owner: finance lead)
intake.business_rules: is_test = 1 marks QA and demo tenants; only status = paid is revenue

notes: A naive SUM over invoices double-counts the duplicated export row and includes test tenants, so it misses the August reference by far more than 0.5%. Passing requires de-duplication plus the test-account exclusion, stated as business rules in definitions.md.
